content.text: TV-MA20193 SeasonsDrama: A group of childhood friends wrestle with the virtue of faith, the possibility of redemption, and the problem of evil.SEASON 3 STREAMING APRIL 12Plans start at $10.99/month.Sign Up NowWatch TrailerA Pivotal Season, Captured on FilmSeason 3 of Euphoria was filmed on new Kodak motion picture film stock in 35mm and 65mm. Creator Sam Levinson and cinematographer Marcell Rév collaborated closely with Kodak to commercialize the new stock in each format. Season 3 is also the first narrative television series to shoot a significant volume of 65mm film, providing an expanded image on-screen that mirrors the characters’ journeys out of high school and into the wider, wilder world.Remember This FeelingThe new era begins April 12.
